This thing shall destroy all!!!" ~ Gary Holt Watch video demo shot by Gary on his iPhone LOL This pedal is what Gary calls a "Game changer!!! I can just pull this out of my backpack and play a gig right there. It's my stage-ready tone in a box." 1. PREAMP Section: Shaping Your Core Sound An homage to the revered silverface amplifier *wink wink* with the following controls: GAIN / BASS / MIDDLE / TREBLE / MASTER / CONTOUR 2. DRIVE Section: Evoke the Paranormal Energy Gives you Gary's iconic Paranormal pedal sound, with these controls: DRIVE / VOLUME / MID BOOST 3. TWO INTERNAL SWITCHES OUTPUT LEVEL SWITCH: "down" position gives you an Instrument Level, perfect for your amp's clean channel. "up" position makes the pedal a stand-alone preamp. OD TONE internal switch: "down" position gives you a flat response, "up" brings the twisted glory of Tone control - like when the tone on your OD pedal is on maximum.
